integrity: The proof uses the published Gaussian Mercer spectrum, positive finite-rank decomposition, and trace formula; no numerical spectral truncation is used as proof. Low-order cumulant formulas in prior literature are explicitly excluded from the originality claim.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotics hold for fixed \(d\) and fixed cumulant order while \(\beta\to\infty\); no uniformity in growing dimension or order is claimed.
The Berry--Esseen statement is an upper rate and is not claimed sharp.
The result concerns the limiting null quadratic form after the sample-size limit and does not prove a joint finite-sample \(n,\beta\) theorem.
title: Power-sum asymptotics for vanishing-bandwidth BHEP spectra
